name: Unbroken Bostip
description: Sink the hips with the staff braced against the forearm, qi coiling in the legs like a drawn spring.

name: Blazetipcap
description: Lean the whole body behind a short push of the staff into the opponent's guard, testing how it gives.

name: Gustbostip
description: Meet the blow and draw the staff back slowly along it, bleeding the force away down the shaft.

name: Tipcapcanter
description: Release the coiled legs in one bounding step that carries the staff's tip to the opponent's chest.

name: Crippling Taperend
description: Slip the tip between the opponent's hands and prise outward, breaking the guard open for a heartbeat.

name: Charter Balancenode
description: Lock the staff against the opponent's guard and press on, qi building until the guard begins to sag.

name: Splitting Leftgrip
description: Let the accumulated pressure go in one thrust that punches through the sagging guard at its weakest point.

name: Intent Sweepstep
description: Ride the thrust's recoil into a rebound strike and a following sweep, each blow carrying the same stored push.

name: Ironbostip
description: Hold the staff upright while the qi field spreads outward from the body and wraps the shaft in a faint sheath.

name: Splitting Staffcentre
description: Jab so that the qi field reaches a hand's width past the tip, touching the target before the wood does.

name: Murk Tipcap
description: Brush blows aside with the outer edge of the field before they ever meet the staff itself.

name: Silt Rightgrip
description: Step forward and let the field flow ahead of the feet, smoothing the ground and reducing noise.

name: Waning Bogrip
description: Press the field out from the tip to feel the opponent's stance and weight through the air before contact.

name: Gust Whitewood
description: Sweep the staff in a wide low arc with the field adding half a pace of reach beyond the wood.

name: Gyve Spinbreak
description: Curl the field around an opponent's weapon beyond the shaft's end and draw it off line with a turn of the wrists.

name: Rumble Roll
description: Compress the field into the tip at the last moment and drive it through a narrow gap in the guard.

name: Scalding Roundstaff
description: Spin the staff and let the qi field cast outward in a ring, striking all who stand close around the user.

name: Lambasting Tipjab
description: Lunge with the field concentrated at the tip, the thrust landing a full pace beyond the staff's wood.

name: Taperend Fastness
description: Plant one foot against a step or stone and hold the staff across the body, using the ground as a brace.

name: Blockassault
description: Strike the end against a wall or post beside the opponent so the rebound arrives from an unexpected side.

name: Gusttipcap
description: Turn a blow down a slope or stair by angling the shaft along the fall of the ground.

name: Bogrippounce
description: Use the staff's end as a third foot on gravel or mud, keeping steps firm where the opponent slips.

name: Bogripthrash
description: Use a narrow doorway or gap as a guide, driving the staff straight through it where the opponent cannot sidestep.

name: Blaze Pivot
description: Swing the staff around a post or pillar to arrive from behind it, binding the opponent's arm against it.

name: Bogripgreave
description: Pin a fallen opponent against a stair edge with the shaft laid across the shoulder and one foot braced.

name: Shadetipjab
description: Walk the opponent back along a narrow ledge with the shaft pressed to the chest, qi steady against each stumble.

name: Lotbostip
description: Seize a rise or hollow in the ground to flip the exchange, then strike twice from the better footing.

name: Resilient Tipcap
description: Stand with the staff's end resting on the ground beside the lead foot, qi seeping slowly into the earth.

name: Rumble Staffcentre
description: Drag the tip across the ground in a scratch and finish with a jab that follows the same line.

name: Iron Leftgrip
description: Stamp the staff's end down to jar a rushing opponent's footing and stop the charge at the mark.

name: Torrent Rightgrip
description: Step along the line the staff has just marked, the lingering qi guiding each foot to firm purchase.

name: Hardened Bogrip
description: Draw a ring in the dust around the feet and turn aside blows that cross it with a quick spin of the shaft.

name: Furrowing Block
description: Rap the end on the marked seam so qi jumps along it and stings the foot of anyone standing there.

name: Spinbreak Greave
description: Mark a line the opponent steps across and hold it with qi, tugging their leading foot back as it touches.

name: Splitting Tipjab
description: Step down a marked line and strike at its end, the qi trail guiding the staff straight to the target.

name: Chimebostip
description: Scratch two crossing lines and hold the centre with qi so that the opponent's steps there falter.

name: Sinister Balancenode
description: Charge a marked patch of ground with qi, so that the first foot to cross it is dragged back and down.

name: Equipoise Bostip
description: Walk a full ring with the staff trailing qi, so that the ground inside tires anyone fighting there.

name: Tipcaphauberk
description: Stand with the staff's two ends held as equals, one end guarding and one end ready, like two courts of one house.

name: Lancing Block
description: Strike first with the near end and let the far end swing round to follow within the same breath.

name: Adamant Roundstaff
description: Parry with one end and mirror the motion with the other, so a second blow meets the same answer.

name: Racing Sweepstep
description: Step left and right in matched pairs, each foot landing as its twin leaves, so the stance never rests.

name: Sanguine Block
description: Pour weight into a high overhead stroke that settles on the opponent's guard like water into a basin.

name: Facet Taperend
description: Bend the guard with the pressure like a reed in a current, yielding a hand's breadth and springing back.

name: Iron Whitewood
description: Block with one end while the other end moves along a second track to strike the open flank.

name: Grinding Pivot
description: Sweep both ends in succession like wings opening, the second end catching the foot the first end missed.

name: Chimebogrip
description: Answer each incoming stroke with an equal stroke on the opposite side, turning a duel into a matched exchange.

name: Crippling Roundstaff
description: Press the staff's two ends against the opponent's two arms and hold them as if between basin walls.

name: Successive Bostip
description: Deliver two paired strokes, each from the opposite end, whose second stroke lands where the first has opened the guard.

name: Pivotthrash
description: Bring both tracks of the staff to one point at once, the two strokes meeting inside the opponent's guard.

name: Facet Staffcentre
description: Stand tall on the balls of the feet with the staff raised high, qi field spread like a hawk's wings.

name: Rumble Tipcap
description: Jab upward and outward at the opponent's raised arm, the field lifting the tip a little higher.

name: Tipcapcloak
description: Hold the staff flat overhead and let falling blows glance off the screen of qi laid across it.

name: Might Rightgrip
description: Drop low in a single step with the staff's end leading and the body falling in behind it like a stoop.

name: Vigorous Bogrip
description: Fix the tip on the opponent's weakest point and let the field read their balance before the stoop begins.

name: Fastening Sweepstep
description: Hook the near end behind the opponent's guard-arm like a talon and pull it down and away.

name: Irontipjab
description: Pass over the opponent once to draw the guard up, then stoop down on the same line with the far end.

name: Glintbostip
description: Rise high, then fall with the whole body onto the staff, its qi-laden far end plunging through the guard.

name: Intentbogrip
description: Circle overhead in short steps with the field hanging above the opponent, threatening a stoop from every side.

name: Bostipplating
description: Stand sideways with the staff laid along the forearm, one arm for guard and the other for strike.

name: Bogripplating
description: Slide along the guard track to meet a blow in the middle of the shaft and carry it past the hip.

name: Sanguine Pivot
description: Slide along the strike track so the far end travels in a long curve to the opponent's flank.

name: Granite Tipjab
description: Walk a curved path around the opponent in short sidesteps while the staff keeps both tracks open.

name: Mantled Balancenode
description: Turn the staff in a small tight eddy that catches a blow and spins it round the user's guard.

name: Glint Spinbreak
description: Cut across the line of the opponent's attack with a jab that uses the guard's own motion to carry it in.

name: Whitewood Greave
description: Part a flurry of strikes to either side of the staff the way a stone parts a stream.

name: Gust Pivot
description: Move down the guard track while the strike track arcs round, so both reach the flank together.

name: Hoarfrost Tipcap
description: Loop the staff round the opponent's weapon arm like a river round a bend and strike as it tightens.

name: Intent Roll
description: Let both tracks rise together in a sudden surge of strikes that overflow the opponent's guard on both sides.

name: Resilient Balancenode
description: Stand with a qi field lit at each end of the staff, near end and far end poised in balance.

name: Granite Taperend
description: Snap the near end into the opponent's wrist at close quarters while the far end holds the guard.

name: Bogripcuirass
description: Reach out with the far end's field to turn a distant blow before it has crossed half its path.

name: Granite Bogrip
description: Swap near and far ends through the hands in a single step, turning the closer reach into the longer.

name: Subduing Roll
description: Drive the far end between the opponent's weapon and body and wedge outward, forcing the guard wide.

name: Roll Barrage
description: Hold both end fields against the opponent's chest and shoulder, squeezing the space for their steps.

name: Facet Tipjab
description: Strike with the far end's field and follow at once with the near end through the same opening.

name: Intentbostip
description: Gather both fields over a long draw-back, then cut in a wide stroke that lands with both ends.

name: Aegis Leftgrip
description: Face into the wind with the staff slanted across the body, taking the bearing before the first move.

name: Gustblock
description: Jab on the bearing with the wind at the back, the shaft driven a little farther by the gust.

name: Chime Rightgrip
description: Turn an incoming blow across the wind so the shaft meets it at the angle where it slips.

name: Leftgrip Spurt
description: Move along an unseen edge with short, sure steps, the staff held out to feel the open air.

name: Granite Whitewood
description: Time a downward cut to a gust so the wind adds weight just as the shaft lands.

name: Hoarfrost Bostip
description: Rest in a low guard when the wind falls slack, saving qi until the next gust returns.

name: Crippling Sweepstep
description: Hold the staff steady on the bearing while the opponent swings wide, then cut the swing short at its end.

name: Staffcentre Torment
description: Sweep into the wind with the shoulder behind the staff, forcing the opponent's lead leg back.

name: Rumble Spinbreak
description: Turn the staff on the gust's change and drive the tip into the gap that opens as the opponent's guard shifts.

name: Staffcentre Thrash
description: Drive forward on the bearing with the staff at the opponent's chest, giving no step back to the wind's edge.

name: Rumbleblock
description: Wait for the gust, then strike on the bearing with the wind's full push, scattering the opponent's own attack.

name: Immovable Whitewood
description: Plant the staff upright in front of the body as in the oath, one hand over the other on its top.

name: Roundstaff Maelstrom
description: Thrust the full length of the staff in the open with the field carried a little beyond the tip.

name: Unflinching Taperend
description: Cross the staff and parry with the oath's firm line, the arms never yielding the centre.

name: Blurring Rightgrip
description: Stride out across open ground with the field wide, the staff trailing from one hand like a flag.

name: Splitting Pivot
description: Swing the staff through a full arc that finishes exactly at the opponent's side, as an oath is kept.

name: Aegis Bostip
description: Spread the qi field wide around the staff, thin as plateau wind and as hard to push through.

name: Waningtipcap
description: Hold the staff out over the plateau and let the field feel for any enemy approaching in the open air.

name: Gyve Sweepstep
description: Draw the staff across the ground in a line the opponent has sworn not to cross, and hold it with qi.

name: Rumblepivot
description: Cut through the opponent's guard with the field spread wide, striking from slightly farther than they expect.

name: Leftgrip Maelstrom
description: Bring the staff down upon the opponent's weapon and hold it, the oath's weight pressing at the contact.

name: Scything Tipcap Thrash
description: Whirl the staff low in the open and let the field sweep out wide, striking every foe within its swing.

name: Furrowing Tipjab
description: Pierce far down the open bearing with the field's full reach behind the tip, the wind itself carrying it on.

name: Hoarfrost Balancenode
description: Keep the staff turning slowly across the body while the feet keep moving, never giving the opponent a still target.

name: Trouncing Block
description: Step off the line and jab from the side the opponent has just left unwatched.

name: Torrent Bogrip
description: Let the guard slide along the shaft to pass a strike along the staff and off the near end.

name: Torrent Roll
description: Drift sideways in small steps so the opponent turns but never squares up, the staff always between.

name: Granite Spinbreak
description: Tap the staff's tip against the opponent's lead hand while the feet keep moving, never lingering to be struck.

name: Gust Bogrip
description: Wheel the staff in the open in a wide circle that sends every attack down toward the ground.

name: Bostipspurt
description: Slip in past the opponent's lead hand on the move and strike at the ribs before the guard can turn.

name: Hoarfrost Leftgrip
description: Guard by moving after the attacker's blade, taking the staff to it before it reaches the body.

name: Mayhempivot
description: Sweep the staff in a great wheeling stroke across open ground, the qi gale driving back all within it.

name: Facet Roundstaff
description: Stand fixed on a single bearing, the staff and qi field aligned with it, letting the opponent circle in vain.

name: Harpooning Tipjab
description: Jab down the held bearing so the tip and its field arrive along a line the opponent cannot read.

name: Mantled Bostip
description: Turn the staff a few degrees off the bearing to deflect, then return to the line unchanged.

name: Torrent Sweepstep
description: Shift the feet with the changing wind while the staff stays pointed, keeping the bearing unbroken.

name: Waning Taperend
description: Set the field to the bearing and read the opponent's movement as a change in the wind's feel.

name: Pivot Maelstrom
description: Cut straight along the keeper's bearing so the stroke cannot be turned by a parry's angle.

name: Thorn Roll
description: Lay the staff across the opponent's weapon along the bearing and hold it there without wavering.

name: Aegis Balancenode
description: Turn the field around the shaft without turning the bearing, so guard changes and line stays.

name: Facettipcap
description: Drive the staff and its field down the bearing in one long thrust that gives the guard no time to turn.

name: Tiered Staffcentre
description: Shape the field from a thin spear to a wide sheet in turn, striking each time in a different manner.
